site_id.description: Site to report on; must belong to the caller

equipment_id.description: Single unit to report on; must belong to the caller

service_request_id.description: Completed service request of the caller that a SERVICE_INTERVENTION report documents. Required for that type and refused (400) for every other type

from.description: Inclusive start of the period, ISO 8601 UTC with Z (e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z). Required except for SERVICE_INTERVENTION, which defaults to the start of the request's work. Checked by the service, not by the schema

to.description: Inclusive end of the period, ISO 8601 UTC with Z (e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z). Required except for SERVICE_INTERVENTION, which defaults to the request's completion. Checked by the service, not by the schema
